name: Tanakadate Mieri
source:
A young ojou-sama famous rhythmic gymnastics star and Rena's closest friend. She's very friendly and gets along great with Kazuki.

Mieri has a strong sense of responsibility she started gymnastics from an early age, and both of her parents grew up in a gymnast family. Mieri has no experience in international competitions, she turns to Rena and Kazuki for advice.

"I just do my best as usual. Practice never betray me."
